summary: Owner report: tapping an input/select on a phone zooms the page in until manually zoomed out (iOS Safari focus-zooms any form control with computed font-size < 16px; inspector ran 13px desktop / 14px narrow). Delegated brief (BRIEF-mobile-input-auto-zoom.md at repo root) returned a CSS-only decision: @media (any-pointer: coarse) override sets select + input to explicit 16px, appended after the final max-width: 1100px block so the 14px narrow-layout rule cannot win; ids/uncontrolled-input/wasm rebinding untouched. Verified: tsc + vite build green; headless-Chromium probe 12/12 via vite preview — desktop 13px (wide) and 14px (narrow) unchanged, touch 390px and touch 1280px (hybrid case) both 16px.
